categories.main_business_segments: Poly Developments and Holdings Group Co., Ltd. primarily operates in real estate investment, development, and comprehensive real estate services. Its business includes residential property development, commercial property operations such as office buildings, hotels, shopping centers, exhibition halls, and industrial parks, as well as property management and integrated community services. The company also focuses on rental housing and asset management to enhance operational income.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes green building technologies, including 100% of new projects meeting green building design standards and extensive use of prefabricated components like ALC wall panels and precast concrete. It applies intelligent supply chain management systems and advanced technologies such as AIGC for integrated design, procurement, and settlement processes. The company also pilots rapid construction systems to shorten project cycles and implements energy-saving and low-carbon technologies in construction and operations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Poly Development serves a broad customer base including individual homebuyers, commercial tenants, and institutional clients. Its residential products cater to differentiated customer needs across core cities, while commercial properties serve office tenants, retail operators, and hospitality clients. The company targets core urban areas and key development regions, focusing on customers seeking quality housing and integrated lifestyle services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China with a focus on 38 core cities including major metropolitan areas such as Guangzhou, Shanghai, Beijing, Shenzhen, Chengdu, Wuhan, and others. It has projects distributed in southern, eastern, northern, central, and western China, with a minor presence overseas. The geographic strategy emphasizes national coverage with concentration in economically developed and strategically important urban clusters.
categories.supply_chain_position: Poly Development operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the real estate supply chain. It engages in land acquisition, property development, construction management, sales, and property operation services. The company also manages asset operations and integrated services, positioning itself as a full-cycle real estate developer and operator with control over project development and customer delivery.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on building a competitive real estate ecosystem platform with three main business pillars: optimizing real estate investment and development, expanding property operation and rental housing, and strengthening integrated real estate services. R&D efforts focus on green building technologies, intelligent supply chain management, rapid construction methods, and enhancing product quality and customer experience. Innovation also targets cost reduction, energy efficiency, and sustainable development aligned with national policies.
categories.revenue_model: Poly Development generates revenue mainly through property sales, including residential and commercial real estate. It also earns income from property leasing, property management services, hotel operations, and other integrated real estate services. The company’s revenue streams include upfront sales proceeds, rental income, and service fees from property and community management.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: As a leading central state-owned enterprise in China’s real estate sector, Poly Development holds a top market position with the largest sales volume in the industry for consecutive years. It competes with other major state-owned and private real estate developers in core cities. The company leverages its strong brand, financial stability, and comprehensive capabilities to maintain leadership and competitive advantages in product quality, service, and market share.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Poly Development reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 311.7 billion, a 10.14% decrease from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 5 billion, down 58.56%. The company maintains total assets of around RMB 133.5 billion and a net asset base of RMB 19.76 billion. Despite market challenges, it sustains a large scale with a broad project portfolio and continues to optimize asset structure and cash flow management.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Poly Development emphasizes high-quality, customer-centric products branded under the 'Tianyue Renhe' series, focusing on green, healthy, safe, and convenient living experiences. It differentiates through integrated services, including property management, commercial services, hospitality, and elderly care, providing one-stop solutions for better living. The company’s strong brand reputation, financial strength, and innovation in construction and service quality underpin its competitive edge.
